notes.title: Update Notes - 05/14/2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/d73a6a70c774478715977be74703f45eb97e2807.png
2025/05/14 Patch Note

 The player's base movement speed has been increased from 6.5 to 10.
 The upgrade cost for increasing gold acquisition in the base has been reduced.
 In base upgrades, movement speed now increases by 5% per level, up to a maximum of 25%.
 In missions, upgrade cards for movement speed now grant a 5% increase per level, up to a maximum of 25%.
 The HP of elite enemies in some stages has been reduced.
 The amount of gold earned after winning a stage has been increased.

notes.title: October 09 Update Notes & New Trailer Release
notes.content:
"Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" will participate in the Steam Next Fest starting on October 15. The demo has been updated on the game’s Steam page, and a new trailer has been released. Players can experience the latest version, featuring all difficulty levels of the first stage and unlocking the BOSS character—Eve.

We’ve also released the latest trailer:
[previewyoutube=NeTGLtleh_U;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/4dba78e578017e398f2582005367ecf8e73881c9.png
(The demo includes the newly unlockable BOSS character—Eve)

The current version has improved UI, game balance, and added character animations. We will continue internal testing and optimization. Future updates will include character voiceovers and other planned features. Interested players, please follow our official channels and add "Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" to your Steam wishlist!

2024/10/09 Patch Note

 Adjust and optimize some UI elements
 Add a fifth difficulty level
 Add new character unlocks
 Optimize enemy collision warning box
 Add supply crate indicator arrows
 Add evolution weapon synthesis hint interface
 Add 3-second invincibility after revival
 Balance stage difficulty
 Change mouse cursor design
 Adjust base upgrades and character enhancement values and required money

notes.title: Progress Sharing 02
notes.content:
Over the past two months, we have not only advanced the development progress but also optimized the completed projects. This demo update has significantly enhanced the UI interface, skill effects, sound effects, and character illustrations, aiming to provide a more immersive and comfortable gaming experience for all players.


Below are the before-and-after comparison screenshots:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/0411ede8008647d07b76a3af37b722a26864bcc8.gif
Upgrade Interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/fd61ea948f4b6513f213d13808be3601d7e4e9e3.png
Collection Library

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/b273ac70e2f479d34ec3e2a0d11a515771065999.gif
Character & Level Selection Interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/a8ad563d7add049b32470146f762da5c2b9c67e6.gif
Combat Interface

The new update is now live, and the screenshots above don't fully capture the improvements—come and try it out to see for yourself! If you have any suggestions for changes, please feel free to let us know. We truly appreciate your feedback!

Additionally, the fourth level has been completed, and the squad's character designs are now in the final stages. We plan to participate in Steam's NEXT FEST in October, with the goal of launching the game by the end of the year. Stay tuned!

Please add "Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" to your wishlist to get the latest updates as soon as possible!

notes.title: Progress Sharing 01
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It’s been a while since the demo of "Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" was released. We are still actively developing and this is our first attempt at this new game genre. We hope for your support. If you haven’t tried "Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" yet, feel free to download the demo version and please add it to your wishlist!

In the coming period, we will continue to share updates about the game’s progress. Your feedback and ideas are always welcome!

Now, let’s take a look at the members of the first Valkyrie Squad "Stray Cat Mercenary Legion":
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/d8665b01f568afc0e72a910b8ee6666f12133796.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/3c8e1995e49385c9a79659ae3f8816ef2f835fff.gif
Emily Smith
Known for her calm and professional demeanor within the squad, Emily always prioritizes missions and treats her comrades with utmost seriousness. Growing up in a war-torn environment, she possesses outstanding combat skills and sharp battlefield awareness. Throughout numerous missions, her impeccable shooting accuracy and fearless courage have made her a core member of the team.

Ultimate Move: Storm Barrage
When leading the squad, she can unleash "Storm Barrage," rapidly firing multiple bullets in a specified direction with trajectory shifts.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/39c01dcfc997ece7667958f9a4be4297e263887c.gif
Park Yoonhee
A young and vibrant warrior in the mercenary group, Park has been fascinated and talented with high-tech weapons since childhood. Since joining the mercenary group, she quickly became the team's tech expert, displaying exceptional combat skills on multiple missions. Although she appears dominant and invincible in battle, she is very caring in private, especially towards those in need.

Ultimate Move: Radiant Glow


As the squad leader, she can deploy "Radiant Glow," shooting five plasma beams that sweep enemies and apply a slowing effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/9fab2a5911510ac14db4006e8debb15298943359.gif
Karmar Singh
A tech genius in the Stray Cat Mercenaries, Karmar excels in mechanics and electronic engineering, especially in operating various drones. Coming from a family embroiled in political strife, she resolved to change her circumstances through her own efforts. Joining the Stray Cats, her skills and intellect have led the team to numerous victories. She holds herself to the highest standards in every mission, striving for perfection.

Ultimate Move: Ultimate Command - Annihilation
As the squad leader, she can execute "Ultimate Command - Annihilation," summoning a massive drone that delivers a devastating strike to enemies, quickly turning the tide of battle.

Here is the link to the special moves video of the Stray Cat Mercenary Legion:
https://youtube.com/shorts/vmcLhTqiUEo?si=CprE7UpGmc17mzAp


"Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" is expected to feature multiple levels, each with various difficulties and unique themes in scenery, enemies, bosses, and interactables.

This is the second level, "Zombie Planet," which is largely complete. We will continue with the production of subsequent levels, so stay tuned!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/77a2e3d425a23f339b3e0741e8089da5916ddc3d.png
